shared_elements: quadruped animal shown from above/in profile with legs splayed
curved linear element (arc/band) crossing the field
justification: The only overlap is that both include an animal with a head and splayed limbs (a lizard-like creature in A, a feline-headed central being in B), which is a generic correspondence. B is a dense, symmetrical composition of two elaborately costumed human figures flanking a central frontal creature, with headdresses, staffs, discs and patterned garments, none of which appears in A, whose sparse field shows a single isolated reptile above a plain curved line rendered in low, unadorned outline.
